title.narrative: Support for the Security and Justice Programme in Nepal

description.narrative: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) funded Security and Justice Programme will continue the Integrated Programme for Strengthening Security and Justice’s dual focus of tackling criminal violence and other causes of public insecurity, in particular gender-based violence and strengthening the service delivery capacity of the Nepal Police and other key duty-bearers.
